'''grendelX Senate Droid Invasion & Sandspeeders v1.2 (DS)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[grendelX]]
* '''Published:''' 13 March 2005 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif|label=Invasion}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Drop!|Cor-D-drop.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Invasion
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Invasion grendelX DS 2005 GPN.txt|Download]]

== Introduction ==

Both decks went 1-1  to finish 4(-59) for 6th out of 8  players today...

* 1x {{CardLink|Resistance (Dark)|Ref3-D-resistance.gif|label=Resistance}}

Ten shields posted after Drop! in the Dark Side list, all named (Reflections III shields; Firepower (V) VS6, Reactor Terminal (V) VS3).

== Notes ==

* GPN post 5949 holds two decks; this page is the Dark deck, and the Light deck is on the (LS) page.
* Dark Side total 60 (no section counts are given). Drop! is posted right before the 10 shields; taken as the starting effect holding them (uncertain).
* Posted 'Lord Maul x2' is the Reflections III Lord Maul (the draft had Darth Maul); a unique card, dested as posted.

== Strategy ==

DS 3-4/LS 2-5 13 March 2005 Rating 1524
